rec-e1.subject: Re go boloketse lefelo la gago mo Gadit
rec-e1.body:
Dumela {name},

O simolotse go ikwadisetsa {plan} mme wa emisa pele fela o fetsa.

Re go boloketse sengwe le sengwe, mme o ka tswelela gone fa o emisitseng teng.

- Malatsi a le 14 ka mahala, mme ga go duedisiwe sepe gompieno
- Morago ga teko: {price}
- Re tla go romelela segopotso ka imeile pele teko e fela
- O ka khansela nako nngwe le nngwe mo tsebeng ya gago ya akhaonto, ka go tobetsa gabedi
rec-e1.next: Go na le sengwe se se sa tlhaloganyesegeng? Araba fela imeile e, mme re tla go thusa.

rec-e2-family.subject: Se bana ba gago ba se bonang mo Gadit
rec-e2-family.body:
Dumela {name},

Re ne re batla go go bolelela ka bokhutshwane se se emetseng bana ba gago mo Gadit:

Lefoko lengwe le lengwe le ba kopanang le lone, mo bukeng, mo tirong ya gae kgotsa mo puisanong, le fetoga lefoko le ba le tlhaloganyang tota.

- Tlhaloso e e lekaneng ngwana wa gago, e na le setshwantsho sa tlhaloso nngwe le nngwe
- Metshameko le boikatiso tse di dirilweng ka mafoko a bone
- Thuso ka tiro ya gae
- Lebota la batsadi le le go bontshang kgatelopele ya ngwana mongwe le mongwe

Ikwadiso ya gago ya {plan} e bolokilwe, mme go setse fela kgato ya bofelo.
rec-e2-family.next: Ga go duedisiwe sepe gompieno, mme o ka khansela nako nngwe le nngwe mo tsebeng ya gago ya akhaonto.

rec-e2-indiv.subject: Se se go emetseng mo Gadit
rec-e2-indiv.body:
Dumela {name},

Re ne re batla go go bolelela ka bokhutshwane se se go emetseng mo Gadit:

Lefoko lengwe le lengwe, mo bukeng, kwa tirong kgotsa mo puisanong, le fetoga lefoko le o le tlhaloganyang ka botlalo.

- Ditlhaloso tsotlhe tsa lefoko, ka setshwantsho sa nngwe le nngwe
- Metshameko le boikatiso tse di dirilweng ka mafoko a gago
- Bukana ya gago ya mafoko e e bolokang sengwe le sengwe se o se ithutileng

Ikwadiso ya gago ya {plan} e bolokilwe, mme go setse fela kgato ya bofelo.
rec-e2-indiv.next: Ga go duedisiwe sepe gompieno, mme o ka khansela nako nngwe le nngwe mo tsebeng ya gago ya akhaonto.

rec-e3.subject: A go na le sengwe se se go kgoreleditseng? Re bolelele
rec-e3.body:
Dumela {name},

Ikwadiso ya gago ya {plan} e sa ntse e bolokilwe.

Fa go na le sengwe se se go thibelang, araba fela imeile e, mme re tla go thusa.

act-first-word-family.subject: Lefoko la ntlha la bana ba gago mo Gadit
act-first-word-family.body:
Dumela {name},

Tsela e e gaisang ya go simolola: nna le ngwana wa gago metsotso e le tlhano, lo batle lefoko le le lengwe le a kopaneng le lone gompieno, mo bukeng, mo tirong ya gae kgotsa mo puisanong.

- Kwala lefoko mo lefelong la go batla
- Bona tlhaloso e e lekaneng ngwana wa gago, e na le setshwantsho sa tlhaloso nngwe le nngwe
- Le boloke mo bukaneng ya mafoko, mme go tswa foo le tsena mo metshamekong ya gagwe

Lefoko le le lengwe gompieno, mme ngwana wa gago o setse a simolola go aga kitso ya gagwe ya mafoko.
act-first-word-family.next: O tlhoka thuso? Araba fela imeile e.

act-first-word-indiv.subject: Lefoko la gago la ntlha mo Gadit
act-first-word-indiv.body:
Dumela {name},

Tsela e e gaisang ya go simolola: batla lefoko le le lengwe le o kopaneng le lone gompieno, mo bukeng, kwa tirong kgotsa mo puisanong.

- Ditlhaloso tsotlhe tsa lone, ka setshwantsho sa nngwe le nngwe
- Kwa lefoko le tswang teng
- Le boloke mo bukaneng ya gago ya mafoko mme o ikatise ka lone mo metshamekong e mekhutshwane

Lefoko le le lengwe gompieno, mme kitso ya gago ya mafoko e setse e gola.
act-first-word-indiv.next: O tlhoka thuso? Araba fela imeile e.

act-first-word-2.subject: Lefoko le le lengwe, metsotso e le tlhano
act-first-word-2.body:
Dumela {name},

Kakanyo e nnye ya gompieno: tlhopha lefoko le le lengwe mo bukeng, mo tirong ya gae kgotsa mo dikgannyeng, mme o le batle mo Gadit.

Mo motsotsong fela o bona ditlhaloso tsotlhe tsa lone, ka setshwantsho le dikai, mme le bolokwa mo bukaneng ya mafoko gore o ikatise.

Ke ka tsela e kitso ya mafoko e golang ka teng: lefoko le le lengwe ka nako.
act-first-word-2.next: O tlhoka thuso? Araba fela imeile e.

act-add-child.subject: Kgato e nngwe gape: oketsa ngwana wa gago
act-add-child.body:
Dumela {name},

Gadit Family e diretswe bana ba gago, mme ga go ise go okediwe ngwana ope mo akhaontong. Go tsaya motsotso:

- Kwala leina la ngwana wa gago mme o tlhophe setshwantshwana
- Golaganya sedirisiwa sa gagwe kwa ntle ga lefoko la sephiri, kgotsa o dirise Mokgwa wa bana mo sedirisiweng sa gago
- Go tswa foo lefoko lengwe le lengwe le a le batlang le a bolokwa, mme o bona kgatelopele mo lebotong la batsadi
act-add-child.next: O tlhoka thuso? Araba fela imeile e.

act-return-family.subject: Tshimologo e khutshwane mo Gadit, e e go diretsweng
act-return-family.body:
Dumela {name},

Re batla go netefatsa gore bana ba gago ba bona sengwe le sengwe se Gadit e ka ba se nayang. Dikgato tse tharo tse dikhutshwane tsa go simolola beke eno ke tse:

- Oketsa ngwana mo akhaontong, fa o ise o dire jalo (motsotso o le mongwe)
- Batlang lefoko le le lengwe mmogo mo bukeng kgotsa mo tirong ya gae
- Bula metshameko, e e dirilweng ka mafoko a ngwana wa gago a a bolokileng
act-return-family.next: A o batla gore re go bontshe kafa e dirang ka teng? Araba imeile e, mme re tla rulaganya mogala o mokhutshwane wa metsotso e le 10.

act-return-indiv.subject: Tshimologo e khutshwane mo Gadit, e e go diretsweng
act-return-indiv.body:
Dumela {name},

Re batla go netefatsa gore o bona sengwe le sengwe se Gadit e ka go se nayang. Dikgato tse tharo tse dikhutshwane tsa go simolola beke eno ke tse:

- Batla lefoko le le lengwe le o kopaneng le lone gompieno
- Le boloke mo bukaneng ya gago ya mafoko
- Ikatise mafoko a gago ka metshameko e mekhutshwane
act-return-indiv.next: A o batla gore re go bontshe kafa e dirang ka teng? Araba imeile e, mme re tla rulaganya mogala o mokhutshwane wa metsotso e le 10.
